snippet.title: The Fridge Is (NOT) Empty - Announcement and DEMO Trailer
snippet.description:
BIG NEWS! 📣

Announcing “The Fridge Is (NOT) Empty”! 🥳

Our new short psychological horror adventure game about living in a house with a fridge that seems empty, but it's not.

Wishlist and play the DEMO now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3553240/The_Fridge_Is_NOT_Empty/

#gamedev #indiegame #indiedev
